about.title: About Me
about.introduction: I'm a software engineer based in Morocco. For 7+ years I've been designing and building software end to end: enterprise e-commerce platforms with Java & Spring Boot for brands like Carrefour and Chanel, modern front-ends in React, Angular and Vue, and AI-powered products. I care about clean architecture, performance and great user experience, and I help teams turn complex requirements into reliable products.
about.thankYou: Thank you for taking the time to learn more about me and my work.
